author: Totally Not Mark
description:
There was a time when I thought I'd never finish this series. But having dedicated the past month to Korra's adventures alongside Mako, Bolin, Tenzin and Asami... I'm amazed to see the finish line! Book 4! We did it! Time to sit back and relax as I cover the latest arc of Avatar!

MUSIC COVERS USED:

Avatar Orchestral Suite (DPops)
To Heal (Eliott Tordo Erhu Player)
Kuvira's Theme (ForTiorl)
The Power of Balance (Rush Garcia)
Avatar Main Theme (Patrik Pietschmann)
Ending (Eliott Tordo Erhu Player)
Avatar Wan's Theme (Eliott Tordo Erhu Player)
Greatest Changes (Anthony Lo Re Composer)
title: My First Time Watching The Legend of Korra’s Ending
